# Development Plan - 2026-09-18

**Generated from**: `.github/research/2026-09-18-research.md`  
**Issues created**: 5  
**Total estimated effort**: ~11-14h

## Priority Classification

- **HIGH** (1 issue, ~3-4h): Critical quality/reliability gaps affecting user experience
- **MEDIUM** (2 issues, ~4-5h): Security hardening and permission boundaries
- **LOW** (2 issues, ~4-5h): Multi-provider support and runtime optimizations

## Executive Summary

The research identified 3 HIGH/MEDIUM priority actionable items (2 confirmed bugs carry-forward from 2026-09-17, 1 new permission boundary fix from 2026-09-18) plus 2 LOW priority enhancements. The top 5 items total ~11-14h of estimated implementation effort.

### Top Priority (create issues for all 5)

1. **Compaction trigger using actual token count** (HIGH, ~3-4h)  
   - **Category**: core  
   - **Current State**: `estimateMessagesTokens` uses character estimate only (chars/4), no `previousRequestInputTokens` tracking  
   - **Impact**: Dense content (disassembly, minified JS, image dumps) causes compaction to never fire, leading to context-window-exceeded errors and squeezed output budgets  
   - **Files**: `src/core/compaction.ts`, `src/core/sessionManager.ts`, `src/core/orchestrator.ts`, `src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts`

2. **Subagent approval boundary enforcement** (MEDIUM, ~2-3h)  
   - **Category**: tool  
   - **Current State**: Task tool has TODO comment (line 536-557) noting need for permission inheritance via `deriveSubagentSessionPermission`, currently `inheritPermissions: true` in `buildSubagentConfig` (line 562) suggests full inheritance  
   - **Impact**: Subagents may inherit parent approvals instead of respecting explicit delegation boundaries  
   - **Files**: `src/tool/tools/task.ts`, `src/agent/subagent-permissions.ts` (referenced but needs creation/verification), `src/permission/`

3. **Windows CWD executable search disable** (MEDIUM, ~2h)  
   - **Category**: tool  
   - **Current State**: No `NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath` environment variable setting found in codebase  
   - **Impact**: Security vulnerability — malicious repo can ship fake `rg.exe`/`git.exe` and get it executed on Windows  
   - **Files**: `src/utils/process.ts` (new helper), `src/cli/program.ts` (startup call), `tests/utils/process-windows.test.ts` (new test)

4. **GitLab MR and Bitbucket PR linking** (LOW, ~2-3h)  
   - **Category**: command  
   - **Current State**: `src/cli/commands/codeReview.ts` is GitHub-only (uses `gh` CLI)  
   - **Impact**: Multi-provider VCS support enhancement — currently GitHub-only is acceptable, this is nice-to-have  
   - **Files**: `src/cli/commands/codeReview.ts`, `src/git/remoteDetection.ts` (new helper), `tests/cli/commands/codeReview-vcs.test.ts` (new test)

5. **Concurrent subagent tool execution** (LOW, ~3-4h)  
   - **Category**: agent  
   - **Current State**: Tool execution appears sequential in `src/tool/tools/task.ts` and `src/core/agenticChat.ts` (needs verification)  
   - **Impact**: Runtime optimization — subagents run slower with sequential tool execution but still work correctly  
   - **Files**: `src/tool/tools/task.ts`, `src/core/agenticChat.ts`, `src/agent/runtime.ts` (if exists), `tests/tool/tools/task-concurrent.test.ts` (new test)

## Dependencies & Constraints

- All implementations must pass `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run build`
- Coverage must remain above 40% line coverage (CI enforcement via jq on `coverage/coverage-summary.json`)
- All local imports must end in `.js` (ESM + `module: NodeNext`)
- Commits must follow conventional commits with allowed scopes: `cli, core, providers, config, server, agent, tools, ci, deps, tests`
- Tests for Windows-specific features must conditionally skip on non-Windows platforms
